about: Short, made-up test lines written by the team (fake names, TestBank, .example links). Written BEFORE the Chinese and Malay rules and not changed after. Because the same people wrote the rules, results on this set are a smoke test, not real-world accuracy. The Chinese and Malay lines need a teammate who speaks the language to check them.
